title: clematis ranunculoides var. pterantha
intro: Clematis ranunculoides var. pterantha, commonly known as Pterantha, is a plant species that belongs to the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its unique white flowers with a distinctive shape. The plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pterantha include its ability to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a valuable remedy in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Pterantha include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
